realism_engine.medium: unretouched digital photograph, straight out of camera
realism_engine.focus: critical focus on the near eye, shallow depth of field, background falls softly out of focus
realism_engine.film_emulation: Kodak Portra 400 colour response, gentle highlight rolloff
realism_engine.grain: fine natural sensor grain, slightly stronger in the shadows
optical_truth: subtle chromatic aberration at the frame edges
exactly one soft specular catchlight per eye, matching the key-light direction
a few loose hair strands slightly out of place
realism_engine.skin_rendering: visible pores, micro-texture, uneven tone, peach fuzz catching the light, natural sebum highlights, faint blemish left in place — never smoothed, never plastic, never airbrushed
realism_engine.lighting_rule: exactly one identifiable key source with a stated direction; shadows must fall consistently on face, neck, clothing, wall and floor
realism_engine.composition_rule: slightly off-centre, imperfect framing as if captured in the moment, with breathing room around the subject
realism_engine.expression_rule: one micro-expression in progress — a half-formed smile, eyes focused on something specific — never a held, posed look
realism_engine.colour: natural white balance, no HDR, no global glow, contrast of a lightly curved RAW file

negative: plastic skin, airbrushed, poreless, wax figure, doll-like, beauty filter, smoothing, perfect symmetry, flawless, masterpiece, 8k, ultra detailed, hyperdetailed, HDR, global glow, bloom, oversaturated, teal-and-orange grade, studio flat lighting with no direction, two or more catchlights per eye, inconsistent shadows, extra fingers, fused fingers, six fingers, deformed hands, warped ears, crossed eyes, mismatched irises, floating jewellery, text artefacts, watermark, logo, body-measurement look, exaggerated proportions, CGI render, 3D render, illustration, anime, oil painting
negative_video: morphing face, identity drift between frames, sliding features, warping hands, jittery teeth, mouth flapping out of sync, sudden lighting change, extra limbs appearing, background objects popping in and out

video_motion_defaults.camera_move: locked-off tripod, almost imperceptible handheld drift
video_motion_defaults.lip_sync: lip shapes must match the dialogue; no mouth morphing between words
video_motion_defaults.no_cut: single continuous take, no cut, no zoom punch
